style: Realistic natural look matching photographic realistic trees, desaturated post-Soviet abandoned countryside, crisp fine detail, soft overcast daylight from the top-left, no outline, no glow.

assets.desc: an old rusty oil pumpjack (nodding donkey) seen from the side: walking beam with horsehead, A-frame samson post, counterweights, motor on a concrete pad, faded paint, oil stains
a ragged field scarecrow on a wooden cross: old torn quilted jacket, burlap sack head with a faded cap, straw sticking out
a small abandoned Russian log hut (izba) with a collapsed roof: dark grey weathered log walls, roof caved in with broken rafters and rotten planks, empty window with broken shutters, moss and weeds
a small abandoned meteorological station: white louvred wooden Stevenson screen box on legs next to a tall thin mast with a wind vane and cup anemometer, peeling white paint, rust
a huge ancient solitary English oak (Quercus robur), enormous gnarled thick trunk, wide spreading broad crown of dense green leaves, a few dead branches, majestic
a large fallen pine tree lying horizontally on the ground: long trunk with rough bark, torn-out root plate with earth on the left end, broken dry branches and a few needles on the right
